system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The model applies three general lenses — spec conditions, value/asset flow, trusted-but-unbound inputs — and scores each scope by exposure × difficulty.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt differs by posture/role (map, dig, verify, confirm) and prompt text lives in src/agent/prompts.ts; exact assembly not shown in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: `read`: read loaded source/corpus or files created in the sandbox.
env_context_strategy.note: The MAP phase has the model enumerate a scope inventory, which DIG then reuses.

context_compaction.note: Transcript windowing is mentioned; the exact mechanism is not shown, so truncate_oldest is the closest value.

observation_format.evidence_quote: `bash`: run one policy-gated local command in the copied workspace.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: the model emits exactly one JSON tool action per turn, or a `done` object after writing `findings.json`.
tool_call_format.note: The per-step loop uses JSON-in-text. A continuous pi session driver is auto-selected for some providers and likely uses native tools (inferred).

tool_count.note: The default tools are read, write, edit and bash. The done action is not counted as a tool.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: `edit`: replace text in a file inside the copied sandbox workspace.
edit_primitive.note: The write tool writes whole files.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: `flounder run <clue>` can execute prepare -> map -> dig -> synthesize -> verify -> confirm -> report as a tracked workflow.
loop_primitives.note: An inner ReAct loop runs inside a fixed phase pipeline. Verify/refute stages act as execution-grounded checks.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: MAP** (`map` role): a bounded breadth pass whose only job is to enumerate a *complete* scope inventory to `scopes.json`.
planning_granularity.note: The persisted scope inventory is re-read by DIG.

multi_agent_topology.note: Role sessions run in a fixed sequence.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: then gives each claim an isolated confirm-or-refute session.
delegation_mechanism.note: Sessions are spawned by the harness, not by the model.

human_in_loop.note: Operators can select scopes (`audit --scope`), but no approval gating is described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The inventory is **checkpointed right after the MAP phase and after EACH dig**

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: `~/.flounder/history/<target>/`: durable memory, scope inventory, build cache, and project history.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: A run KILLED mid-way therefore resumes by skipping MAP and the already-audited scopes and redoing only the one in-flight dig.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Stronger findings also pass differential confirmation, independent refutation, and faithful-PoC appeal checks.
self_verification.note: The harness re-runs the cited test after applying the fix (differential confirmation).

rollback.evidence_quote: applies the fix to the pristine source, re-runs the *same* cited test, then restores the source.
rollback.note: Harness-level restore; runs use a copied workspace.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: calls the model again until the agent finishes or the step budget is exhausted.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: This spends the expensive model where it matters
cost_controls.note: Budgets are mentioned in the usage docs; the exact budget kind is unclear.

execution_isolation.note: Default is an OCI (Docker) or Apple container. Host mode is available only with --allow-host-execution.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: bind-mounts only the copied workspace and package cache
filesystem_access.note: Root filesystem is read-only; the model cannot edit baseline files.

network_policy.evidence_quote: uses Docker's `--network none` for sealed inspect/confirm commands
network_policy.note: The confirm phase gives classified read/fork/fetch commands egress (allowlist-like).

permission_model.evidence_quote: Open-world commands get egress only through the explicit capability classifier described below.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: `flounder group` runs validated positive, negative, control, replay, and multi-target work items through the same daemon queue and audit kernel.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Public network broadcast, transfer, credential use, persistence, exploit optimization, destructive commands, and paths outside the copied workspace are blocked.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Autonomous white-hat security auditor for AI-driven code review, bug bounty research, exploit construction, and execution-grounded verification.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Codex-style and Claude Code-style providers can be routed through the same sandbox and audit contract.
